title: The five daily prayers
intro: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha – and when each one is.

learn.html: The second pillar of Islam is Salah – the highest way to show obedience and thanks to Allah. By praying we want to come closer to our Lord and earn His love. In a day and a night there are five prayers: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha.

learn.text: The time of the five daily prayers

items.label: Fajr – from dawn until just before sunrise
Dhuhr – when the sun has moved a little past the middle of the sky, until late afternoon
Asr – when the sun leans to the west, until just before sunset
Maghrib – from sunset until it is completely dark
Isha – when the sunlight is completely gone, until just before dawn

learn.text: Besides the five daily prayers we also pray

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We learn to pray from early childhood, and we pray regularly from the age of ten for the rest of our lives.
